# Package states

Generated by the state test (`go test -run TestStates -update`); do not edit.

## Axes

- **origin**: in-session, on-its-own
- **timing**: ahead, purchased
- **credits**: left, used-up, overdrawn
- **price**: free, priced
- **invoice**: empty, draft, issued
- **receipt**: empty, draft, issued
- **payment**: none, paid

## Rules

| rule | bucket | reason | why | resolved by / guarded by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| unpaid | needs-action | collect | Bought on its own, and not paid | payments.set |
| invoiced | impossible |  | A package is always on an invoice, which says its price | by construction: buying a package puts it on a draft invoice, and nothing takes it off one but deleting it |
| overdrawn | impossible |  | No more sessions use a package's credits than it has | packages.save; sessions.update |
| receipt-is-the-payment | impossible |  | What was received is what its receipt says | by construction: Paid is copied from the receipt's line |
| paid-nothing-due | impossible |  | Only what is owed is paid | payments.set; packages.save; documents.saveDraft |
